# RQ1 gate table (generated by scripts/make_gate.py; the decision is the humans')

Preregistered quantity: flip rate (full_A) - flip rate (feat_A_meanPos), in points. Criterion: >= 10 points with the 95% CI excluding 0. Only rows marked `gate` (fresh families, E3, filter f_pilot, mean errors fitted on fresh families) are the gate. The noise-control column is the flip rate of x̂_B + η in the same cell (mean over noise seeds): how often destroying B's information alone gives A's answer.
